dialogues.speaker: Training Ground Announcement
dialogues.text: "This training ground is open to everyone as a place to train and work out. Please follow the rules and observe basic etiquette. Only by encouraging each other can we improve as one!"

dialogues.speaker: Training Ground Announcement
dialogues.text: "In addition, newcomers are recommended to seek the help and advice of our resident coach, to make sure you're doing it right. Remember, we're here to train, and muscle strains kill gains!"
